summary: Route plugin permission requests through the native approval gate and reorder the two persistent activity rows.
features: Require the model to invoke an enabled remote plugin tool exactly once so the platform-native approval gate handles permission.
Keep the tool-specific activity result directly below Attach and place the overall response status beneath it.
Retain every existing activity indicator, timer, provider identity, and cancellation state.
Keep automatic Workshop Memory release synchronization enabled.
fixes: Prevent AI-generated preflight approval prompts that expose account identifiers or cause double approval.
Accept approve or cancel only when the backend holds a native pending approval.
Prevent denied plugin actions from being reframed as a new approval request unless the user repeats the original task.
Preserve provider-aware summaries, argument redaction, Web Search curation, and Developer Mode isolation.
validation: Native approval instruction, no-manual-preflight, redaction, pending-decision, and denial-terminal regression coverage
Generated DOM order validation for tool activity followed by overall completion status
Release and Workshop Memory synchronization metadata validation
